description: This Java class defines a Spring component 'AutowiredDeviceConnectionAdapter' that extends 'EventBusDeviceConnectionAdapter' and injects a 'DeviceConnectionService' implementation via dependency injection. It serves as a configuration component to wire the device connection service with an event bus in a Spring Boot environment.

classes.name: AutowiredDeviceConnectionAdapter
classes.description: A Spring component that extends 'EventBusDeviceConnectionAdapter' and injects a 'DeviceConnectionService' implementation, enabling event bus-based device connection handling.

methods.name: setService
methods.description: Setter method to inject the 'DeviceConnectionService' implementation, annotated with @Autowired and @Qualifier to specify the bean.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Overrides the method from superclass to return the injected device connection service.
